posts.text: Trading from Home vs Trading from a Co-Working Space, which is better? — I think trading from home is better if you have a quiet space and can avoid distractions. You save money and get more flexibility. A co-working space is useful if you need a fixed routine and a professional environment. At the end of the day, discipline matters more than the place you trade from.
